description: Données Ouvertes Sur Les Lignes Ferroviaires (Parcours Total En Km) Au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Banque Mondiale. Les lignes ferroviaires correspondent à la longueur de la voie ferrée disponible pour le service ferroviaire, quel que soit le nombre de voies parallèles. Lien vers la source cliquez ici. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Banque Mondiale. Its tags are lignes-ferroviaires. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-03-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
